premise.en: Naomi edits a comedy audio drama from her fourth-floor walk-up; Graham, across the landing, surveys buildings for a living and reads every note like a structural report. A noise complaint aimed at the wrong neighbor, a prop love letter in the wrong mailbox, and a listening session he mistakes for a work request keep them guessing. Over eight chapters you decide what Naomi says to his face — and whether either of them needs a note ever again.
premise.zh: Naomi在四楼的无电梯公寓里给一部喜剧广播剧做剪辑；对门的Graham是建筑测量师，读每张便条都像在读结构报告。一张投错人的噪音投诉、一封投错信箱的道具情书、一次被他当成工作求助的试听邀请，让两人一直在猜。八章里，由你决定Naomi当面说出什么——以及他们还需不需要再写便条。
